name: Malayan Banking Berhad
overview: 2026年，Maybank完成收购Maybank Ageas Holdings Berhad剩余30.95%股权，使其成为全资子公司，从而全面整合保险与回教保险业务。此外，公司通过股息再投资计划发行新股，并派发首次中期股息。
overview_en: In 2026, Maybank completed the acquisition of the remaining 30.95% equity interest in Maybank Ageas Holdings Berhad, making it a wholly-owned subsidiary and fully consolidating the insurance and takaful businesses. Additionally, the company issued new shares under its dividend reinvestment plan and declared its first interim dividend.

segments.name: 集团保险与回教保险
segments.note: 今年完成对Maybank Ageas Holdings Berhad剩余股权的收购，实现全资拥有。
segments.note_en: This year, completed the acquisition of the remaining equity interest in Maybank Ageas Holdings Berhad, achieving full ownership.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以4.83亿令吉现金收购Maybank Ageas Holdings Berhad剩余30.95%股权，完成后成为全资子公司。
actions.text_en: Acquired the remaining 30.95% equity interest in Maybank Ageas Holdings Berhad for RM4.83 billion cash, making it a wholly-owned subsidiary upon completion.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 现金代价4.83亿令吉，并已获得国家银行批准。
actions.text_en: Proposed acquisition of the remaining 30.95% equity interest in Maybank Ageas Holdings Berhad for a cash consideration of RM4.83 billion, with Bank Negara approval obtained.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年涉及股息再投资计划的新股发行及股息派发。
segments.note_en: This year involved new share issuance under the dividend reinvestment plan and dividend distribution.

actions.title: MAYBANK - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 宣布首次中期股息每股RM0.31，其中RM0.05可选择再投资新股，新股发行价定为RM9.80。
actions.text_en: Declared a first interim dividend of RM0.31 per share, of which RM0.05 can be elected for reinvestment in new shares, with the issue price fixed at RM9.80 per new share.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 完成收购Maybank Ageas Holdings Berhad剩余30.95%股权，保险与回教保险业务成为全资子公司。
model_changes.text_en: Completed the acquisition of the remaining 30.95% equity interest in Maybank Ageas Holdings Berhad, making the insurance and takaful business a wholly-owned subsidiary.
